<USER_REQUEST>
You are an adversarial bug hunter operating under the updated bug-hunter-rust v1.1.0 skill.
Perform a deep, exhaustive, line-by-line code audit on:
- crates/callisto-manifests/ (cargo.rs, npm.rs, atomic.rs, lib.rs)
- crates/callisto-format/ (changeset.rs, bump.rs, pre.rs)
- crates/callisto-vcs/ (lib.rs)
- crates/callisto-changelog/ (write.rs, render.rs, lib.rs)
- crates/callisto-conventional/ (commit.rs, severity.rs, parse.rs)
- crates/callisto-model/ (identity.rs, version.rs, path.rs, ecosystem.rs, severity.rs, tag.rs, package.rs, exec.rs)

Search for defects #251 through #320 across all 6 Hazard Taxonomies and 6 Code Smells:
1. Discarded data & unused CLI/struct parameters (_opts, _config, _loaded, unwrap_or defaults).
2. Ordering, mutability & CST format preservation (toml_edit decor loss, inline tables, array sorting, whitespace/indentation fingerprinting).
3. Spec-vs-code drift against docs/01-spec.md and docs/00-design.md.
4. Silent fallbacks, swallowed I/O errors, unwrap_or defaults.
5. Boundary inputs (UTF-8 BOM \u{FEFF}, CRLF line endings, path traversal ../, unicode, git detached HEAD, annotated tags).
6. Crash-safety & atomic write guarantees (fsync parent directory, sync_all, NamedTempFile).

Do NOT edit any files. Inspect files directly using view_file and grep_search.
Return a detailed technical report listing each confirmed defect with file:line references, classification, root cause analysis, failing scenario, and recommended fix/test.
</USER_REQUEST>
